description: Object-upright success for the Cheez-It rzz-hold experiment.

angle.definition: rzz = world z dot object z, reconstructed from cheezit_rot6d

window.end: first post-grasp timestep where eef_pos[0] <= gate_x
window.aggregation: max angle_deg over the inclusive window

missing_gate_policy: A rollout that never reaches the gate is not counted as angle-success.
